title: Climate and LGBTQ+ activists march outside Cop31 talks in Antalya
seoTitle: Antalya march for climate and LGBTQ rights

tea.why: Activists are protesting against worsening climate conditions, false climate finance promises, coal mining expansion, and crackdowns on rights.
tea.want: They demand climate justice, public climate funds instead of exploitative loans, an end to coal mining destruction, and LGBTQ+ rights.
tea.changed: Nov 14: Activists and international campaigners held a mass march in Antalya on Saturday during the UN Cop31 climate talks.

summary: Thousands of climate activists, trade unionists, women's movements, and opposition political party members from Turkey and around the world descended on Antalya for the UN Cop31 climate talks. Gathering in a central square and at Aydin Kanza Park, protesters organised a counter-summit and a mass march on Saturday. Demonstrators highlighted issues including worsening climate conditions, unfulfilled public climate finance promises by the Global South, and the expansion of coal mining destroying local forests and villages. LGBTQ+ activists, facing recent increased persecution in Turkey, led a section of the civil society march with rainbow flags while protected by a cordon of international campaigners. Turkish police enforced a massive security operation, frisking attendees twice, searching bags, setting up steel barriers, and examining placards.
organizers: Friends of the Earth England, Wales and Northern Ireland
demands: Climate justice and genuine adaptation funds without interest-bearing loans
Public money for climate action instead of exploitation by private companies
Halt to coal mining projects destroying forests and villages
Protection of LGBTQ+ rights and an end to state crackdowns
response: Turkish police conducted a massive security operation, searching bags and frisking attendees twice at Aydin Kanza Park, cordoning off the entire route with steel barriers, and photographing placards.

updates.text: Thousands of climate and international activists held a mass march in Antalya on Saturday during the UN Cop31 talks.
